description: The plot illustrates the relationship between recent sequence ratio and perplexity, as well as recent sequence ratio and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis on the left is labeled “Perplexity” and has a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis on the right is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A solid orange line with circular markers represents “Perplexity”, starting at approximately 4.63 when the recent sequence ratio is 0, decreasing to a minimum of approximately 4.32 when the recent sequence ratio is 60, and then increasing to approximately 4.58 when the recent sequence ratio is 100. A dashed brown line represents “Full Cache PPL”, starting at approximately 4.63 when the recent sequence ratio is 0 and remaining relatively constant at approximately 4.52 until the recent sequence ratio is 80, then increasing to approximately 4.63 when the recent sequence ratio is 100. A solid blue line with circular markers represents “GPU Mem. Ratio”, starting at approximately 40 when the recent sequence ratio is 0, increasing to approximately 63 when the recent sequence ratio is 60, and then increasing to approximately 93 when the recent sequence ratio is 100. A dashed gray line represents “Full Cache GPU Mem.”, starting at approximately 63 when the recent sequence ratio is 0 and remaining relatively constant at approximately 62 until the recent sequence ratio is 80, then increasing to approximately 65 when the recent sequence ratio is 100.
